description: Use this when the person wants to take back a change made here (a logged set, meal, weigh-in or any other) while its Undo is open. Give the undo.id the change came back with. Do not use for a change they made in the Almost Fire app itself.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

undoId.description: The undo.id a change came back with.

name: undo
title: Undo a change
